meta.title: 특수구문과 결합한 복잡한 절
meta.note: 업로드된 정답·해설 Unit 47 Q01의 대표 원문과 정답 논리(create, It is ~ who 강조구문)를 직접 대조해 다각도 구조판단 문항으로 변환함. 확인된 대표 원문 범위만 source-aligned 처리함.

items.sentence: While there's plenty of research that shows that people who work with their brains create all kinds of stresses for themselves, it's the people who focus on the why of their jobs, as opposed to the what and the how, who can manage the day-to-day problems more efficiently than those who do not.
items.prompt: that people who work with their brains ___ all kinds of stresses에서 알맞은 동사를 고르세요.
items.explanation: that절의 주어 핵심은 복수명사 people이고 who work with their brains는 people을 수식합니다. 따라서 복수동사 create가 맞습니다.
items.memory: 긴 관계사절을 걷어내고 that절의 주어 핵심어 people과 동사를 연결
